{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
filtered = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (df['channel'] == 'paid_search')]

# Compute conversion rate: fraction of converted orders
n_total = len(filtered)
n_converted = filtered['converted'].sum()
conversion_rate = n_converted / n_total

print(f"Total NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH: {n_total}")
print(f"Number who converted: {n_converted}")
print(f"Conversion rate: {conversion_rate}")"}
